title: Resolve a codepth-three quotient of class H(4,3)

source.citation: Lars Winther Christensen, Orin Gotchey, and Alexis Hardesty, Sampling Algebra Structures on Minimal Free Resolutions, arXiv:2303.13687

translation.notes: Noether reproduces the ordinary minimal graded resolution of the paper's class H(4,3) example and verifies Betti totals (1,5,7,3). Classifying the multiplicative Tor-algebra structure remains outside the case.
